modelRouting.routingRationale: Two disjoint deterministic direct ports over frozen native graph/store shapes; export seam freezes before findings consumes it.

objective: Add native findings & export owners for every genuinely advertised Blueprint findings/export operation without touching retry-stopped query/engine semantics or creating duplicate graph/store authority.

advertisedExport.legacyAuthority: blueprint scripts graph export returns full current generation JSON; not present in daemon METHODS

verifiedSurface.currentRustImplementation: none; engine currently returns typed unsupported_operation
verifiedSurface.negativeClaim: Only these seven advertised operations are in scope; no claim that unadvertised formats or remediation effects exist.

libExportOwnership.timing: after export & findings source freeze, before public tests
libExportOwnership.overlap: no worker may edit lib.rs; checkpoint rebased to integration owner's current in-flight crate-root composition

ownedExtensionOverride.newDisposition: existing native-graph owner extends only persisted module-surface facts; current hash remains pre-write checkpoint

frozenSeams.findings: pub fn execute_findings(generation: &Generation, request: &BlueprintRequest, context: &RequestContext, state_dir: &Path) -> Result<Value, BlueprintError>
frozenSeams.export: pub fn execute_export(generation: &Generation, request: &BlueprintRequest, context: &RequestContext) -> Result<Value, BlueprintError>
frozenSeams.evidencePack: pub fn build_evidence_pack(repo_id: Option<&str>, generation_id: &str, findings: &[Value]) -> Result<Value, BlueprintError>

sourcePortPolicy.reuse: Existing graph tree-sitter walk becomes sole native module-surface producer; Generation/GraphNode/GraphEdge/FileReport & store lossless evidence carry surfaces; findings never rescans or reparses; no second DB/index/ranker/parser service

dependencyPolicy.gate: graph module-surface & export source hashes/frozen seams must be returned before findings execution; integration/qualification waits all

acceptance: extend existing tree-sitter/lexical graph owner to extract deterministic per-file module surfaces matching module-surface.mjs: named/default exports, named/default/namespace imports, named re-exports, star re-exports, specifiers, lines, parse status & closed/open surface reasons
persist surface data only in existing file-node/import-edge evidence with generation identity coverage; no new store, parser service, graph authority, filesystem rescan, or unbounded payload
findings can reconstruct exact module surfaces from loaded Generation alone; unsupported/partial parse stays typed & cannot become closed proof
preserve existing graph nodes/edges/provider precedence, generation identity, store roundtrip & 9/9 acceptance; add focused surface golden fixtures for JS/TS/ESM/CJS ambiguity/star cycles

implement BP001/BP002/BP003 deterministically with stable fingerprints, exact categorical provenance & generation binding; unsupported/open/ambiguous/outside-scan/parse-failed/star-cycle/depth states become typed omissions, never false findings
findings.get supports bounded paths, generation pin, allowStale, baseline delta & explicit coverage accounting; zero findings differs from zero checked
findings.explain returns one exact fingerprint with rule reasoning, source/hash evidence & current/stale generation binding
findings.evidence_pack requires explicit nonempty selection, cap 100, preserves only selected findings/citations & deterministic digest

baseline capture/list uses explicit state_dir only, atomic file replacement, safe names, deterministic delta added/persistent/resolved/changed/unknown, source/detector/config/coverage binding; no implicit home path or graph DB duplication
findings.sarif delegates frozen export seam over same finding objects; remediation remains text only, never authority
all request acquisition obeys context deadline/cancellation, root confinement, request/response byte/candidate/path caps & stable reads; no network/process/Node

tests direct-port donor fixtures for three rules, false-positive omissions, star cycles/depth, ambiguity, stale blocking/allow, baselines, explain/pack selection, corruption skip, cancellation/deadline
Operation::Export returns lossless full current Generation JSON only, deterministic & read-only; SQLite remains sole persisted graph
build deterministic evidence pack with source citations, generation/repo binding & digest; Markdown projection preserves citations/digest
SARIF 2.1.0 projection is bounded, stable, uses same finding objects/rule metadata, & grants no remediation authority
bounded deterministic Mermaid projection only from supplied generation; never a second graph or cache
enforce context cancellation/deadline & response bytes during construction, with typed omissions/failure rather than truncating semantic identifiers
tests match donor JSON/evidence-pack/Markdown/SARIF/Mermaid fixtures including stable ordering, caps & cancellation

requiredOwnedEdits: apply exact libExportOwnership edits after both source lanes freeze; run graph/store plus findings/export focused tests before acceptance
integrationPolicy.queuedStoppedOwnerDependency: Retry-stopped engine owner must later dispatch Operation::Export & six Findings operations to these seams; this packet does not edit engine.rs or bypass its Oracle stop, & unsupported_operation is not parity evidence.
